text.tspan: Journey of Love: Lord, I belong to You
You came to me to be my sacrifice,
Redeemed me, Lord, with a precious price.
By life I keep on walking,
To live a life of loving You—
To love You more, awaiting Your return,
To live my life, nothing else but You.
It spreads through all the earth,
Redeemed to be Your lovely Bride,
To love You more, awaiting Your return,
To live my life, nothing else but You.
Forever I am joined to You,
To love You more, awaiting Your return,
To live my life, nothing else but You.
